# nexus packageupdate get

List upgradable packages

Lists installed packages whose apt candidate version differs from the installed one, sorted by name, with both versions, the candidate's origins, and security: yes when an origin is a -security suite, no when only known distribution origins offer it, otherwise unknown. Reflects the package indexes as of the last refresh. Read-only. Paged with limit and cursor. The result is cached until the dpkg status, the package indexes, the apt sources or the apt preferences change.

## Usage

```
nexus packageupdate get [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # List upgradable packages
  nexus packageupdate get
```

## Flags

```
      --cursor string        Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.
      --filter stringArray   key=value, repeatable: print only objects whose dot path has this value; a repeated key matches any of its values
  -h, --help                 help for get
      --limit int            Page size: default 100, maximum 1000.
  -o, --output string        output format: table, json, jsonl, yaml (default table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise)
      --select strings       print only these dot paths of each object, comma-separated, such as name,properties.state; host and id are always kept
      --tag strings          target every configured host with this tag; comma-separated or repeated for any of several
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
